description: start a campaign with a judge you wrote. the judge runs first and a judge that already passes is refused: it must fail today. print graded output like "ℹ pass 3" and "ℹ fail 2" so progress shows.

as.description: the member you are working as, e.g. builder; writes are never recorded as a person

cwd.description: workspace folder to run in; defaults to the folder this server started in

judge.description: shell command that exits 0 only when the goal is met

seats.description: members who work on it, as member or member:role

name: campaign_start
